name: Aether Apparel
why: Los Angeles outerwear house from 2009: technical shells, motorcycle jackets and merino in plain dark colors, sold from five stores and its own site.
origin: Founded in 2009 by Palmer West and Jonah Smith.

onething.n: from the seat_wave_b_2026-10-08 return; "Mulholland Motorcycle Jacket"

notes.tech: Thread proposed 3 (2026-10-10): Toray Dermizax (membrane); Polartec Power Grid and Polartec micro fleece; Schoeller 3-layer woven; Sorona; Ease Cool nylon; D3O Ghost/Air armour; Manteco cloth — licensed (no proprietary fabric found); share of range 16/91 styles (18%) name a third-party technical fabric or armour. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-10): Every product page states the country (Vietnam, China, Portugal mostly) but none names a factory or maker, and AETHER owns no facility. Mills appear only as performance-fabric brands (Toray Dermizax, Polartec, Schoeller) plus Manteco on one shirt, about a tenth of the range. Dated founding story (2009) but no making history; borderline 3 only if branded membranes count as named mills. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
